verdict: WooCommerce: Choose WooCommerce when WordPress ownership and extension flexibility matter more than an all-in SaaS admin. Scores use the Ecommerce editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Free core and full WordPress/content flexibility
No platform subscription lock-in for the plugin
weaknesses: TCO is opaque until extensions and hosting are priced
bestFor: Merchants optimizing for control over convenience
notIdealFor: Non-technical founders who want zero ops overhead
Teams that want one vendor subscription for everything
tradeoffs: Subscription floors vs payment-processing spreads and GMV/overage fees
App/extension TCO vs native feature depth
Open-source/hosting flexibility vs SaaS operational simplicity
Dropshipping product caps vs catalog automation depth
recommendation: Choose WooCommerce when WordPress ownership and extension flexibility matter more than an all-in SaaS admin. Consider Shopify or BigCommerce for hosted simplicity; Square Online for POS-led retail.
editorialNotes: Ecommerce Wave-1 batch. Approved on ecommerce-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=open-source-platform. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.
